description: Compares a public page now with its earliest Internet Archive (Wayback) snapshot on or after a date: changed yes/no, word similarity, added and removed text lines, and the price-like amounts ($, €, £) before and after. Only what the archive captured is compared; pages the archive never saved return 404. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
